subject: Proposal: hosted API commit uplift & rate-tier realignment for ClearMap.ai
messages:
From: Jules Park <jules.park@clearmap.ai>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Cc: account_ops@clearmap.ai
Date: 2026-07-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Quick check: increasing hosted API commit for Q3/Q4

Hi Evelyn —

Quick context: usage ramped faster than we modeled in H1. We’re seeing sustained higher token volumes for map-gen and summarization pipelines. Procurement asked me to get a firm proposal for a higher monthly commit (and clearer per-tier rate caps) ahead of our renewal discussion.

High-level ask: can Redwood provide pricing for a monthly commit uplift to 12M tokens/month (from our current 4M) with a blended per-token rate and a defined burst rate limit? Also—what would the minimum term look like if we want to lock that pricing (12 vs 24 months)?

Attached is our June usage export for reference.

Thanks,
Jules
Senior Platform Engineer
ClearMap.ai

Attachments: usage_report_Jun2026.csv (csv, 42KB)

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
To: Jules Park <jules.park@clearmap.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-07-02T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick check: increasing hosted API commit for Q3/Q4

Hi Jules —

Thanks for the data — helpful. Looping in Karthik (sales lead) and Marissa (acct AM) to size the commit and draft a proposal. A couple quick clarifying questions so we quote cleanly:

- Is the 12M/month target an average steady-state you expect for the next 12 months, or is it driven by an anticipated product launch (bursty first 3 months then plateau)?
- Any compliance or encrypted-logging requirements tied to the new term?
- Do you need higher burst concurrency / per-second rate limits beyond the standard committed throughput? If so, how many concurrent streams/requests at peak?

We’ll aim to get a formal SOW + rate table by next week.

Best,
Evelyn Hart
Head of Renewals, Redwood Inference

Signature: Evelyn Hart | Head of Renewals | Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-07-07T08:21:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Quick check: increasing hosted API commit for Q3/Q4

Folks — forwarding Jules’ note and Evelyn’s q’s. I reviewed their June export; clear steady uptick across generation endpoints. Proposed approach:

1) Offer two committed tiers: 12M/month at a 12-mo term, and 10% discount if they commit 24M/month on a 24-mo term.
2) Define a burst policy: allow 2x short-term burst (10 minute windows) subject to available capacity; per-second rate limit to be set to 120 requests/sec for their typical request shape.
3) Blended per-token rate table in attached rate_table_v3.xlsx.

I’m proposing a concession: 5% additional discount if they sign and commit within 14 days (we need the headcount quota freed).

Cc'ing Neha for procurement/finance review on the SOW language around invoice frequency and overage handling.

-Karthik

Attachments: rate_table_v3.xlsx (xlsx, 18KB)

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-07-09T11:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Quick check: increasing hosted API commit for Q3/Q4

Karthik —

SOW notes: we should avoid open-ended overage language. Suggest:

- Monthly invoice based on committed tokens; overage billed at a fixed surcharge (1.25x committed rate) with a 30-day grace where overage first applies as courtesy credits once per 12-mo rolling period.
- Include an auto-rollback clause: if sustained utilization drops below 60% for 3 consecutive months, RB will open a review to adjust.
- We need procurement contact from client for PO details (billing address, tax form).

If that looks ok, I’ll draft the SOW and send to Evelyn for signature routing.

-Neha
Director, Revenue Operations

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Jules Park <jules.park@clearmap.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-07-13T09:17:00-07:00
Subject: Proposal: SOW + revised pricing for ClearMap commit uplift

Hi Jules —

Thanks again for the usage file and the call last week. Attached is the SOW (ClearMap_SOW_v2.pdf) and the rate table (rate_table_v3.xlsx) that reflect:

- Option A: 12M tokens/month, 12-mo term, blended rate $0.00048/token, burst allowance 2x for 10-minute windows, concurrency cap 120 req/sec.
- Option B: 24M tokens/month, 24-mo term, blended rate $0.00043/token, burst allowance 3x for 10-minute windows, concurrency cap 180 req/sec.
- Early-signing incentive: additional 5% off if contract executed within 14 calendar days.

Next steps:
1) Confirm preferred option and PO contact.
2) We’ll issue SOW and DocuSign link.
3) Expect provisioning lead time of ~10 business days from signed SOW for capacity reservation.

If you want, we can hop on a 30-minute call Thursday to walk through the rate table.

Cheers,
Marissa Cole
Account Manager, Redwood Inference

Attachments: ClearMap_SOW_v2.pdf (pdf, 32KB); rate_table_v3.xlsx (xlsx, 18KB)

From: Jules Park <jules.park@clearmap.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, SaaSOps Procurement <procurement@clearmap.ai>
Date: 2026-07-25T16:48:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Proposal: SOW + revised pricing for ClearMap commit uplift

Marissa —

Thanks, Option B (24M / 24-mo) is the preferred path for the team. Procurement looped me in with PO details (procurement@clearmap.ai). We’ll route the PO and expect to be able to sign within the 14-day window to capture the early-signing incentive. A few quick operational asks before I kick to procurement:

- Please confirm invoice cadence (monthly invoices vs annual prepaid).
- Can you include a one-time capacity reservation date in the SOW (we’d like Dedicated reservation started by 2026-08-10)?
- DocuSign link for signature so procurement can route immediately.

Once we have those items we’ll turn this into a PO and finalize.

Jules

[In-reply-to: previous thread]

Attachments referenced: none

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
To: Jules Park <jules.park@clearmap.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, SaaSOps Procurement <procurement@clearmap.ai>
Date: 2026-07-25T17:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Proposal: SOW + revised pricing for ClearMap commit uplift

Jules —

Great — appreciate the quick confirm. Responses inline: 

- Invoice cadence: standard is monthly invoicing on committed tokens with option for annual prepay at signing. We’ll mark the SOW for monthly invoices by default; procurement can request annual prepay if they want a single invoice.
- Capacity reservation date: we will put 2026-08-10 as the provisioning target in the SOW (Marissa will update the SOW to include).
- DocuSign: sending a DocuSign envelope now; Marissa will include PO/billing instructions in the envelope.

Marissa: please update the SOW to reflect monthly invoices, the 2026-08-10 reservation date, and attach the DocuSign link in reply.

Evelyn
Head of Renewals | Redwood Inference

Attachment stub: DocuSign envelope (link sent)
